summary: Wired OBS-2 hop-1 ingress span at a single point in request_logger.go: emitIngressSpan (after ServeHTTP) calls middleware.EmitIngress with real request_id (chimw.GetReqID) + task_id (SetIngressTaskID context) and bounded method / route-template (chi RoutePattern, never raw path) / principal-class (SetIngressPrincipalClass context) / HTTP status class / latency_ms. Fail-closed: no emit when recorder unset or request_id/task_id missing; recorder re-validates fail-closed. No body/header/query/raw-path read. Non-breaking: SetIngressRecorder defaults nil (no-op). Added SetIngressRecorder/SetIngressTaskID/SetIngressPrincipalClass + 5 focused tests.
non_claims: router wiring of SetIngressRecorder and handler calls to SetIngressTaskID/SetIngressPrincipalClass are OUT OF LOCK -> handoff to L1/handler owners (cmd/server/router.go, task-creating handlers)
metrics/http.go intentionally not edited (single emission point avoids duplicate hop-1 span)
